rule: first/lowest sustained valid region of four consecutive unique thresholds; MRL auxiliary

config.xi_near_zero_rule: abs(window xi mean) < .05: record CV, use xi range only
config.gof_policy: continuous GPD parametric bootstrap with synthetic-data refitting; no ordinary KS p-value
config.outer_bootstrap_policy: iid resampling of request length observations; same full selection rules and same GOF B
config.synthetic_fit_initialization: parent fitted xi/sigma are starting values only
config.synthetic_fit_optimizer: SciPy genpareto.fit optimizer hook: analytic-gradient BFGS in xi/log(sigma), same likelihood; convergence/objective checked, default Nelder-Mead fallback
